findings.title: Debug Mode Exposes Encrypted Sensitive Data
findings.impact: When DEBUG mode is enabled, encrypted sensitive values are logged to the application log, potentially exposing encrypted credentials
findings.evidence: Line 127: current_app.logger.error(f"Error decrypting token: {value}") logs the encrypted value when DEBUG=True
findings.recommendation: Never log encrypted or sensitive values, even in DEBUG mode. Use a hash or placeholder instead
findings.review_notes: Confirmed - line 127 in utils.py logs encrypted value when DEBUG=True

findings.title: CORS Misconfiguration - Wildcard Origin with Credentials
findings.impact: When CORS is enabled, it defaults to accepting requests from any origin (*) with credentials=True, allowing cross-origin attacks to steal user data
findings.evidence: Lines 179-190: CORS defaults to '*' origins with supports_credentials=True when enabled
findings.recommendation: Remove the wildcard default and require explicit, restrictive CORS configuration in production deployments
findings.review_notes: Valid issue but CORS is disabled by default (line 179 gate). Only applies to deployments that enable CORS without proper configuration

findings.title: Uncontrolled Exception Message Disclosure
findings.impact: Custom exception messages are returned to clients, potentially leaking implementation details
findings.evidence: Line 541: return dict(message=str(e)), 403 - UnauthorizedError exception details returned to client
findings.recommendation: Catch specific exceptions and return generic error messages; log detailed error info server-side only
findings.review_notes: Confirmed - UnauthorizedError is caught at line 540 and str(e) returned to client

findings.title: Shared JWT Token Secret Across All API Keys
findings.impact: All API key JWTs use the same server secret; if compromised, all tokens are compromised
findings.evidence: Lines 88-91: All tokens signed with single LEMUR_TOKEN_SECRET from config
findings.recommendation: Implement per-key HMAC or use asymmetric signing with separate verification keys per API key
findings.review_notes: Confirmed - LEMUR_TOKEN_SECRET is global (line 88), affects all tokens equally

findings.title: Weak Authorization Check for Certificate Creation
findings.impact: Authorization depends on a simple boolean flag is_admin_or_global_cert_issuer which may not properly enforce domain restrictions
findings.evidence: Lines 538-539: Authorization check uses 'is_admin_or_global_cert_issuer' flag without granular per-domain validation
findings.recommendation: Implement fine-grained role-based access control with proper per-domain authorization checks
findings.review_notes: Valid - is_admin_or_global_cert_issuer is a boolean flag; domain-level authorization depends on allowed_issuance_for_domain() which may have its own issues
